family: SGI system ASICs (Hub, Bedrock, HEART, Xbow, Bridge, PIC, IOC3, IOC4, CRIME, MACE, GBE, VICE)

bases.label: constant address
bases.why: CPU interface and memory controller registers (CRIME 1.5 specification, tables 5-7 and 6-12)

bases.label: constant address
bases.why: MACE video in 1, video in 2 and video out, three 0x80000 windows (Linux asm/ip32/mace.h struct sgi_mace)

bases.label: constant address
bases.why: the audio and video block the CRIME specification system map lists at 0x1f400000
